---
title: "Bootstrap Lifecycle"
doc-type: reference
---

This is the routing contract for command ownership, write behavior, and what remains user-owned. Task-specific steps live in [Generate a Repository](../how-to/generate-repository.qmd) and [Bootstrap an Existing Repository](../how-to/bootstrap-existing-repository.qmd).

## Lifecycle Paths

| Path | Sequence |
|---|---|
| New repository | Discover choices, preview `generate --dry-run`, run `generate`, then run `check`. |
| Existing repository | Run `advise`, `audit`, and optionally `resolve-conflicts`; preview `bootstrap-existing` or the narrowest `add-*`; re-run with `--apply`; verify with `check`. |
| Reference Source maintenance | Run `check-skill-sources`; inspect downstream changes with `diff-upstream-candidate`; update canonical inputs and focused tests together. |
| Metadata adoption | Preview `migrate-metadata` or `attach`; apply only after ownership and checksums match the intended boundary. |
| Surface promotion | Preview `migrate-template`, then use `promote-surface` or `promote-template` only when every target is eligible. |

## Command Safety

| Command or family | Writes? | Contract |
|---|---:|---|
| `list-*`, `catalog`, `describe`, `advise`, `audit`, `resolve-conflicts` | No | Discovery, recommendations, and conflict review. |
| `generate` | Yes | Creates a new Downstream Repository; preview with `--dry-run`. |
| `bootstrap-existing`, `add-*` | Only with `--apply` | Preview first; write selected assets without replacing conflicts unless explicitly forced. |
| `check`, `diff-upstream-candidate`, `check-skill-sources` | No | Integrity, upstream-candidate, and source-provenance checks. |
| `upgrade` | Only supported groups with `--apply` | Skills are the narrow refresh slice; other groups remain previews. |
| `migrate-metadata` | Only with `--apply` | Lossless metadata migration; unrecorded files stay user-owned. |
| `attach` | Only with `--apply` | Records Managed Surface ownership without rewriting attached files. |
| `migrate-template` | No | Reports target surfaces and file states. |
| `promote-surface` | Only with `--apply` | Writes one eligible surface atomically; does not change `selected_template`. |
| `promote-template` | Only with `--apply` | Writes all eligible target surfaces as one transaction; changes `selected_template` only after every target conforms. |
| `export-plugin` | Yes | Writes a standalone package; does not mutate a Downstream Repository or Bootstrap Metadata. |

Git-backed refresh and promotion commands require a clean target worktree by default. `--allow-dirty` is an explicit exception, not normal workflow.

## Contract Ownership

| Surface | Owner | Contract |
|---|---|---|
| Reference Source templates, registries, docs, and command behavior | `repo-familiar` | Defines reusable defaults and generated behavior. |
| Downstream files outside recorded generated or Managed Surfaces | Downstream maintainers | User-owned and not replaced by default. |
| Vendored Generated Assets | Generated by `repo-familiar`, then editable downstream | Copies, not live links; drift is expected and reviewed explicitly. |
| `.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml` | Bootstrap Metadata contract | Records provenance, selections, generated assets, Managed Surfaces, and history. |
| Machine-level harness configuration and secret stores | User or workstation owner | Never generated as repository assets. |

## Invariants

- Preview and apply are separate for existing repositories and refresh workflows.
- Missing files can be added only within the selected operation's ownership boundary.
- User edits block checksum-based replacement instead of being overwritten.
- `promote-surface` writes one eligible surface atomically.
- `promote-template` changes `selected_template` only after every target surface conforms.
- No command performs background or live synchronization.

Profile-family selectors and exact lookup commands live in [Profiles and Skills](./profiles-and-skills.qmd). Metadata rationale remains in [ADR 0010](../project-record/adr/0010-metadata-v2-preview-first-refresh.md); the greenfield/existing-repository split remains in the [Python-First Project Plan](../project-record/python-first-project-plan.qmd) and [ADR 0012](../project-record/adr/0012-python-first-greenfield-existing-repository-boundary.md).
